# Ventoy "moderno" theme
# Dark background, teal accent, rounded menu panel and icons per image type.
#
# Enable it by copying this folder to /ventoy/theme_moderno on the Ventoy
# partition and adding to /ventoy/ventoy.json:
#
#   "theme": {
#       "file": "/ventoy/theme_moderno/theme.txt",
#       "gfxmode": "1920x1080",
#       "ventoy_left": "15%",
#       "ventoy_top": "8%",
#       "ventoy_color": "#14b8a6"
#   }
#
# All artwork is generated by tools/make_theme.py (GPLv3, like Ventoy).

desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-color: "#0b1120"
title-text: ""
message-color: "#e2e8f0"
message-bg-color: "#0b1120"

terminal-box: "terminal_box_*.png"

+ boot_menu {
  left = 15%
  width = 70%
  top = 20%
  height = 62%

  menu_pixmap_style = "menu_*.png"

  item_color = "#cbd5e1"
  selected_item_color = "#ffffff"
  selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"

  item_height = 36
  item_padding = 8
  item_spacing = 4

  icon_width = 28
  icon_height = 28
  item_icon_space = 14

  scrollbar = true
  scrollbar_width = 8
  scrollbar_thumb = "slider_*.png"
}

+ progress_bar {
  id = "__timeout__"

}
